key_points: In a statement on Friday, Shaw said it had been a "privilege" to lead the company but that it was "the right time" to leave her post.
Shaw has faced criticism in recent years, including for taking £1.3m in undisclosed payments between 2023 and 2025, while the company has come under scrutiny for its performance.

articles.description: Two analytics firms have attributed the incident to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn (£4.7bn) of digital assets have been impacted by what could be the largest hack in history.
key_points: The world's biggest crypto exchange said about half of those assets had been frozen but that many remained in the hands of the hackers, adding that it will "cover all losses".
Early checks show the incident may have involved an engineer's laptop that had been compromised, which allowed an attacker to make unauthorised withdrawals, Binance said.
Two analytics firms have attributed the incident, which eclipses a record-setting $1.5bn hack on the Bybit exchange in 2025 , to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.
